audit_scope.description: Trust model for Frontier block processing, EIP-2976 (typed transaction gossip), Tangerine Whistle gas repricing, EIP-1344 (CHAINID opcode), and EIP-3675 (PoW to PoS transition). Covers core block validation, P2P transaction propagation, gas economics, opcode execution, and consensus transition.

misclassified_entities.reason: EVM Storage Operations from Frontier state trie subgraph is internal to the EL. SLOAD/SSTORE operations are internal EVM instructions accessing the state trie, not an external entity.
EVM Interpreter from Tangerine Whistle is internal to the EL. The interpreter dispatching opcodes is a core internal component, not an external entity.
Calling Contract from Tangerine Whistle is internal to the EVM. Smart contracts executing CALL opcodes are within the EVM execution context.
Contract Code from Tangerine Whistle SELFDESTRUCT subgraph is internal to the EVM. Bytecode executing within the EVM is not an external entity.
Remote Peer Node from EIP-2976 validation subgraph is a legitimate external entity - NOT misclassified. Keeping for clarity in analysis.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer (Frontier)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer propagating blocks. Can send invalid blocks with wrong state roots, invalid headers, or malicious transactions. All blocks must be fully validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Frontier)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account submitting signed transactions. Can submit invalid signatures, incorrect nonces, insufficient balances. Full validation required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node (EIP-2976)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer sending typed transactions via devp2p. Can send unknown transaction types or invalid payloads. Nodes SHOULD disconnect peers sending unknown types.

trusted_external_entities.name: Message Signer (EIP-1344)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Signed message submission to smart contract
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External user who signed a message potentially on a different chain. Cross-chain replay protection via CHAINID opcode comparison is the defense.

trusted_external_entities.name: PoW Miner (EIP-3675)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: PoW miner producing blocks before the merge transition. Can attempt to manipulate total difficulty to trigger or delay TTD. Block difficulty must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain (EIP-3675)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Consensus layer providing execution payloads and fork choice updates post-merge. Communicates via authenticated Engine API with JWT. Semi-trusted due to authenticated channel, but payloads still validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Execution Node (EIP-3675)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Other execution layer nodes in P2P network. Post-merge, block gossip is deprecated after first finalization. Gossip messages from peers are silently ignored after deprecation.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block must pass full header validation (parent hash, difficulty, gas limit, timestamp), transaction execution, and state root verification.
Transaction must have valid ECDSA signature, correct nonce, sufficient balance for gas*gasPrice + value.
TransactionType must be known and payload must be valid. Unknown types trigger peer disconnection. Types must not be sent before fork activation.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Smart contract call with signed message
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Chain ID in signature must match CHAINID opcode result. Mismatch indicates cross-chain replay attempt.
Block difficulty contributes to total difficulty. TTD check determines merge transition point. Terminal block must be first where cumulative TD >= TTD.
Execution payloads must have difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers, zero mixHash. Fork choice updates provide head/safe/finalized block hashes. JWT authentication required.
Pre-finalization: gossip messages processed normally. Post-first-finalization: gossip messages silently ignored. Deprecation prevents stale PoW block injection.

coverage_gaps: EXT-EVM-STORAGE, EXT-EVM-INTERPRETER, EXT-CALLING-CONTRACT, EXT-CONTRACT-CODE were misclassified as external but are internal EVM components
